SELECT agent_framework, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, AVG(baseline_amount) AS avg_baselines, MAX(baseline_amount) AS max_baselines, generator_model FROM cspaper WHERE agent_framework IN ('CoT', 'ToT', 'Multi-Agent Collaboration', 'Other') AND NOT baseline_amount IS NULL GROUP BY agent_framework, generator_model
